entries.text: GRADUATION SUIT FITTING - FRI 11/6 - SETO HALL - Please sign up for a 10-minute suit fitting appointment during your free period/lunch/after school here: Appointment Sign-Up Link. Slot times will become unavailable when filled (max 5 students per time slot). Email cco@iolani.org or come to College Counseling Office with any questions. Thank you! GRS 9-12---ATTENTION ALL CREATIVE WRITERS: The University of Hawai‘i at Mānoa English Department is hosting a FREE day-long creative writing Write@Mānoa conference for students, teachers, and parents on Saturday, November 21, 2026. We’ll have a keynote address by the Pulitzer Prize finalist Tommy Orange, and lots of small workshops from how to build a fantasy world to how to perform poetry on stage! You can sign up using this Eventbrite link, and you can see more information at our W@M Conference website! If you sign up on Eventbrite by Thursday, you’ll also get a free lunch bento! If you have any questions, please contact Mx. Khactu (akhactu@iolani.org).

entries.title: Shakespeare Competion
entries.text: Rehearsals are today, Wed, 11/4, during meeting period in room C107! If can, please arrive as close to memorized as possible, as we will be doing a "mock competition" to get a feel for how the real competition on November 24th will go. It is okay if you're not fully memorized yet, we will have someone on book for you if you need prompting. If you are supposed to be meeting with your Little on this day, please email Ms. Jackson (jjackson@iolani.org) to find a different time to rehearse. If you haven't yet registered for the school competition on November 24th, it's not too late! Here is a link to do so.

entries.text: It's time for the inaugural Big/Little Sibling 7/11 Meetup!! 7th Graders: Stay in your homeroom. 11th Graders: After attendance and announcements, head over to your little sibling’s homeroom to meet up! entries.title: Biology Club
entries.text: Interested in participating in biology competitions like USA Biology Olympiad? Come to the BioClub meeting tomorrow, Thurs, Nov 5, lunch, I-101! We’ll introduce some biology- related competitions that you can sign up for through interactive activities. Snacks provided :)
